not_a_production_run: This directory is proof evidence. It carries no package-run identity file and is classified UNKNOWN_LEGACY by the canonical engine.
decision_basis: different subject: AIGEN packages live under <AIGEN_VIDNAS_ROOT>/script-packages/, canonical runs under package-runs/
different derivation: asset counts and file existence vs review status markers and human approval
different consumers: next-task-engine maps stage to media actions only (write_script, generate_image_prompts, select_images, submit_video_generation, prepare_resolve_handoff)
no gating: authorizes no agent, gate, publication or approval

vocabulary.unreachable_reason: stage never advances past resolve_handoff; the trailing labels describe post-lane media handling this resolver has no evidence for

consumers.classification: media asset readiness + local tool workflow; never lifecycle progress or authorization
separate_subjects: super-focus.js declares itself separate from both the aigen resolver and package-runs

ambiguity_found_and_closed.finding: /api/cockpit-orientation — the canonical "where am I" endpoint — filled its currentGate field from the AIGEN stage when no package run was active, with no machine-readable scope.
ambiguity_found_and_closed.after: currentGate: "Media lane: image_prompts (4/13)" plus currentGateScope MEDIA_LANE, currentGateIsCanonical false, canonicalGate null
ambiguity_found_and_closed.compatibility: additive — the legacy field is retained

positive_canary.statement: Media progress and lifecycle progress moved independently, each from its own evidence. Neither influenced the other.

negative_authority_canary.statement: There is deliberately no 14-to-AIGEN mapping. Asserting its absence prevents one being added by habit.

drift_policy: RUN_STATE_PROJECTION_DRIFT applies to lifecycle projections only. Differing AIGEN and canonical values are not drift; they measure different dimensions.
